points: Led creative direction and workflow for AI films: Last Boat and Fantastic Beasts (microdrama).
Independent Google Flow trials: Blue Gold and Loveland Draft.
Directed the overall creative vision and stage storytelling, aligning theme and visual presentation.
Kept creative vision and production logistics in sync from concept to final event delivery, with 80% accuracy.
Worked with sponsors and event partners to integrate brand segments into the show, closing business deals at 90% profit.
Worked for months with writers and the creative team to refine the screenplay, narrative arcs, character development and thematic direction.

about: I learned filmmaking the traditional way: on set, behind the camera, assisting the DOP on independent films in Kannada, Tamil and Telugu. Framing, blocking, camera movement and shot division are where my work starts.
From there I took creative direction to a live stage, shaping the theme and storytelling of Miss P&I India in Goa, and then to AI filmmaking as a Creative Director at Headlines Studio.
AI doesn't replace that craft. It gives it a bigger canvas. I direct every generated shot the way I'd direct a set: composition, light, continuity and story first.
canvasLine: AI video tools are my new canvas.
